text: A non-object JSON body 500s on every route, including register and login

Landed in d7f8f24 (Opus agent). request_body.json_body() at all 12 call sites; non-object JSON body is 422 invalid_request, missing/null/unparseable still {}. Behaviour change noted in the wire contract: [] / 0 / false / "" are now 422 rather than the route's missing-field error. 36 new parametrised tests.
